nodes.text: • Determine risk score (Risk Calculation Table CML-A) • Myeloid mutational analysis

• H&P, including spleen size by palpation only (cm below costal margin) • CBC with differential • Chemistry profile, including uric acid • Bone marrow aspirate and biopsy for morphologic review, and cytogenetic evaluation • Comprehensive flow cytometry of marrow aspirate to determine cell lineage of any blasts • Quantitative RT-PCR (qPCR) using International Scale (IS) for BCR::ABL1 (blood) • Hepatitis B panel • Assess for distress

footnotes.text: Hydroxyurea is the preferred option (until the initiation of TKI therapy) to lower very high white blood cell (WBC) counts. Leukapheresis is rarely indicated, except for high-risk indications (eg, persistent priapism, shortness of breath, transient ischemic attack).

Bone marrow cytogenetics with a minimum of 20 metaphases is useful to detect chromosomal abnormalities in addition to the Ph chromosome. The presence of major route additional chromosomal abnormalities (ACAs) in Ph-positive cells (trisomy 8, isochromosome 17q, second Ph, trisomy 19, and chromosome 3 abnormalities) may have a negative prognostic impact on survival in patients with accelerated phase. Fluorescence in situ hybridization (FISH) on the bone marrow or peripheral blood (with a minimum of 100 interphase nuclei evaluated) can be used if bone marrow cytogenetic evaluation is not possible.

Flow cytometry should include the following markers to distinguish myeloid versus lymphoid blasts and distinguish B-lymphoblasts from hematogones: myeloperoxidase, CD117, CD13, CD33, TdT, cytoplasmic CD3, CD19, CD10, and CD20.

Hepatitis B virus reactivation has been reported in patients receiving tyrosine kinase inhibitor (TKI) therapy. However, it is not always possible to reliably estimate the frequency or establish a relationship to drug exposure because these incidences are reported voluntarily from a population of uncertain size.
Refer to the NCCN Distress Thermometer and Problem List, which includes social determinants of health. See NCCN Guidelines for Distress Management (DIS-A).

nodes.text: Ph- positive or BCR::ABL1 positive by qPCR

footnotes.text: Evaluation for atypical BCR::ABL1 transcripts is recommended if Ph-positive by FISH and BCR::ABL1 negative by qPCR. Consider dual fusion FISH (D-FISH) or qualitative reverse transcription polymerase chain reaction (RT-PCR) for the detection of atypical BCR::ABL1 transcripts. See Discussion. Referral to centers with expertise in the management of rare hematologic malignancies is recommended for patients with atypical BCR::ABL1 transcripts.

Asciminib is contraindicated in patients with CML lacking ABL1 exon 2 (eg, b2(e13)a3, b3(e14)a3 isoforms) as it has no clinical activity in these cases (Leske IB, Hantschel O. Leukemia 2024;38:2041-2045; Leyte-Vidal A, et al. Leukemia 2024;38:2046-2050).

nodes.text: • Myeloid mutational analysis • Human leukocyte antigen (HLA) testing, if considering allogeneic hematopoietic cell transplant (HCT)

footnotes.text: FDA-approved generic drugs are appropriate substitutes for brand name drugs (Kantarjian H, et al. Lancet Haematol 2022;9:e854-e861; Haddad FG, et al. J Natl Compr Canc Netw 2024;22:e237116). Brand name and generic drugs approved by the regulatory authorities based on pharmacokinetic equivalence can be used interchangeably. Clinicians should be aware of the potential pharmacokinetic variability and monitor patients closely during transitions, particularly for drugs with narrow therapeutic windows such as nilotinib and bosutinib.

Ponatinib is a treatment option for patients with a T315I mutation in any phase (preferred for AP-CML or BP-CML). It is also a treatment option for CP-CML with resistance or intolerance to at least two prior TKIs or for patients with AP-CML or BP-CML for whom no other TKI is indicated. There are compound mutations (defined as harboring ≥2 mutations in the same BCR::ABL allele) that can cause resistance to ponatinib, but those are uncommon following treatment with bosutinib, dasatinib, or nilotinib.

Asciminib is a treatment option for patients with CP-CML and AP-CML having the T315I mutation and/or previously treated CP-CML and AP-CML. Asciminib is contraindicated in patients with CML lacking ABL1 exon 2 (eg, b2(e13)a3, b3(e14)a3 isoforms).

cml_phase.definition: Disease phase as stated in the case.

blast_lineage.definition: Lineage of blasts by marrow flow cytometry (blast phase).

disease_progression_on_tki.definition: Case states that disease progressed while on TKI therapy.

prior_ap_or_bp_history.definition: Patient had a prior accelerated-phase or blast-phase CML.

in_remission.definition: Patient is in remission after induction chemotherapy plus TKI.

candidate_for_allogeneic_hct.definition: Clinician judgement that the patient is a candidate for allogeneic HCT.

no_other_tki_indicated.definition: Clinician judgement that no other TKI is indicated for the patient.
no_other_tki_indicated.criteria: for patients with AP-CML or BP-CML for whom no other TKI is indicated

resistant_to_primary_imatinib.definition: Case states disease resistance to primary imatinib therapy.

resistant_to_primary_non_imatinib_tki.definition: Case states disease resistance to primary asciminib, bosutinib, dasatinib, or nilotinib.

tki_resistance_or_intolerance_count.definition: Number of prior TKIs stopped for resistance or intolerance.

relapse_after_hct.definition: Hematologic or molecular relapse after allogeneic HCT.

disease_branch_qpcr.definition: Initial branch: Ph-positive or BCR::ABL1 positive by qPCR, versus Ph-negative and BCR::ABL1 negative by qPCR.

risk_score_group.definition: Risk score group from Risk Calculation Table CML-A (uses age, spleen size, platelets, peripheral blasts, basophils, eosinophils). The thresholds are in that table, not in the box text, so rules must be completed from the table.
risk_score_group.criteria_source: guideline (table CML-A; not in the provided text, not yet encoded)

response_milestone.definition: Early treatment response milestone category from BCR::ABL1 (IS) percent at 3, 6, or 12 months after TKI start (months_since_tki_start must equal 3, 6, or 12; otherwise other). red = TKI-resistant; yellow and orange = possible TKI resistance; light green and green = TKI-sensitive.

meets_response_milestones.definition: Meets the TKI-sensitive response milestones (light green or green).

lack_of_response_or_progression.definition: Lack of response (red, yellow, or orange milestone, taken as TKI resistance or possible resistance) or disease progression on TKI.

asciminib_contraindicated.definition: Asciminib is contraindicated when ABL1 exon 2 is absent (b2(e13)a3 or b3(e14)a3 isoforms). Mutation-based asciminib contraindications are in asciminib_contraindicated_mutation.

asciminib_contraindicated_mutation.definition: Kinase domain mutation profile contraindicates asciminib (A337T, P465S, M244V, or F359C/I/V).

bosutinib_contraindicated_mutation.definition: Kinase domain mutation profile contraindicates bosutinib (T315I, V299L, G250E, or F317L).

dasatinib_contraindicated_mutation.definition: Kinase domain mutation profile contraindicates dasatinib (T315I or T315A, F317C/I/L/V, or V299L).

nilotinib_contraindicated_mutation.definition: Kinase domain mutation profile contraindicates nilotinib (T315I, Y253H, E255K/V, or F359C/I/V).

ponatinib_or_hct_contraindicated_mutatio.definition: Kinase domain mutation profile contraindicates ponatinib or allogeneic HCT. Table CML-5 lists no contraindicated mutations for ponatinib or allogeneic HCT, so this is always false.

asciminib_option.definition: Asciminib is a treatment option: T315I mutation, or previously treated CP-CML or AP-CML; not when asciminib is contraindicated.

ponatinib_option.definition: Ponatinib is a treatment option: T315I mutation in any phase; CP-CML with resistance or intolerance to at least two prior TKIs; or AP-CML or BP-CML for whom no other TKI is indicated.

post_hct_cytogenetic_response.definition: Cytogenetic response after allogeneic HCT: CCyR versus less than CCyR or relapse. The CCyR threshold on Ph-positive metaphases is not printed in the box text, so the CCyR rule is not encoded and only relapse is handled.
post_hct_cytogenetic_response.criteria_source: guideline (Criteria for Response and Relapse CML-F; CCyR threshold not in the provided text, not yet encoded)
